# Zack Babtkis — Independent Software Engineering Consultant

> Senior engineer in Los Angeles (ex-PayPal/Honey Senior Staff, ex-Pie).
> Three specialist services, each with a fixed-price entry engagement.
> Contact: zackbabtkis@gmail.com — replies within one business day.

## Services

- [Chrome → Safari & iOS Extension Porting](https://zacharybabtkis.com/safari-extensions/):
  Ports Chrome extensions to Safari on macOS and iOS, including
  DeclarativeNetRequest migration and App Store review. Built Honey's first
  iOS browser extension; owned Pie's Safari/iOS extensions (2M+ users).
  Entry offer: Safari Port Assessment, $2,500, one week. Typical ports
  $15k–$45k fixed; maintenance retainers $2k–$3.5k/mo.

- [MCP Server Development for SaaS](https://zacharybabtkis.com/mcp-development/):
  Production Model Context Protocol servers that put SaaS products inside
  Claude, ChatGPT, and other AI agents — tool-surface design, OAuth, remote
  hosting, directory listing. Built agent-facing APIs and MCP servers at
  ZeroClick. Entry offer: MCP Readiness Audit, $2,000, one week. Typical
  builds $18k–$35k; prototype hardening $8k–$15k; MCP + metering $30k–$60k.

- [AI-Agent Development Enablement](https://zacharybabtkis.com/ai-agent-enablement/):
  Gets engineering teams shipping production software with AI coding agents
  (Claude Code and similar) — harness setup, agent-ready codebase practices,
  embedded pairing. Shipped a production product at a 2M-user company where
  agents wrote the code (https://pie.yt, still live). Entry offer:
  Agent-Readiness Audit, $3,000. Embedded enablement $15k–$30k;
  fractional AI engineering lead $4k–$7.5k/mo.

- [AI-Built POC to Production](https://zacharybabtkis.com/poc-to-production/):
  Takes founders' AI-built prototypes (Claude, Cursor, Lovable, Replit) to
  production — security/data review, tests, auth, deployment. Entry offer:
  Production Readiness Audit, $2,500. Finish-line engagements typically
  $20k–$50k fixed.

## Background

- [About](https://zacharybabtkis.com/about/): 12+ years shipping production
  software — UC Santa Barbara Earth Research Institute, Gimbal, ProducePay,
  five years as Senior Staff engineer at PayPal (Honey: 20M+ users, 30,000+
  retailers, $4B exit to PayPal), then Pie/ZeroClick (2M+ user ad blocker;
  agent-commerce infrastructure). 20M+ combined users across the
  extensions he helped build; led Honey's extension integrations with
  PayPal through the $4B acquisition. Solo products: TrueRate
  (hidden-hotel-fee Chrome extension, 2019–2020) and Unhabit (iOS Safari
  extension for blocking distracting sites,
  https://unhabit.en.softonic.com/iphone).
